scorecard.promise: Meet glide path for top line growth in line with system in FY26 and faster in FY27
scorecard.quote: we shall meet the glide path that we had indicated earlier in terms of the growth, our top line growth, which is in line with the system this financial year and faster than the system in the next financial year.
scorecard.outcome: FY26 revenue reached ₹348,615 Cr vs ₹336,367 Cr in FY25. System credit growth reported at 12% in FY26.

scorecard.promise: LDR downward glide path to 90%-96% in FY26 and 85%-90% in FY27
scorecard.quote: we will try and be in a range of somewhere between 90% to 96% in the year FY '26... And then maybe by FY '27... land somewhere around the 85% to 90% for FY '27.
scorecard.outcome: Exact LDR figures were not disclosed in subsequent reported metrics or quarterly table.

scorecard.promise: Outpace loan growth in coming year FY27
scorecard.quote: we believe and we are very optimistic about outpacing loan growth in the coming year in FY '27
scorecard.outcome: FY27 is ongoing; Sep 2026 reported total AUM growth year-on-year at 15.3%.

scorecard.promise: Pre-merger level growth coming back over medium term
scorecard.quote: you will see the kind of growth that we have used to pre-merger coming back.
scorecard.outcome: Sep 2026 quarterly revenue increased to ₹95,132 Cr from ₹86,994 Cr in Sep 2025. Still tracking over medium term.

scorecard.promise: Enhance return on asset over next 1, 2, 3 years
scorecard.quote: enhance return on asset over the next 1, 2, 3 years
scorecard.outcome: ROA reported at 1.9% in Apr 2026 and 1.8% in Oct 2026.

scorecard.promise: Reasonably healthy growth in savings accounts over 1 to 3 years
scorecard.quote: you should see reasonably healthy growth over a one, two, three-year period in the savings account as well.
scorecard.outcome: Specific savings account growth figures not provided, but total deposit growth was 18.8% YoY in Oct 2026.

scorecard.promise: Upward margin trajectory from next quarter, neutral to positive
scorecard.quote: The trajectory will be upward from the next quarter onwards.
scorecard.outcome: Promised trajectory begins in Q3 FY27; reported quarterly financials for Q3 FY27 are not yet available.

credibility.summary: Management mostly provides multi-year, medium-term qualitative horizons, making immediate quantitative delivery evaluation premature. Annual revenue and PAT continue steady growth.

narrative_vs_numbers: Revenue expanded from ₹87,182 Cr in Mar 2026 to ₹95,132 Cr in Sep 2026, aligning with positive top-line commentary.
ROA dropped slightly from 1.9% in Apr 2026 call to 1.8% in Oct 2026 call despite ROA enhancement claims.
PAT steadily grew from ₹19,285 Cr (Mar 2025) to ₹21,537 Cr (Sep 2026), supporting management's optimism.

guidance.quote: The trajectory will be upward from the next quarter onwards.
